h1.en: Electric 10 Has No Vertical Distance Cell: 25 m beside the Levelling article
h1.zh: 电动10为什么没有垂直距离格：对照「水准测量」时，25 m仍在原页

directAnswer.en: The Electric 10 Series concrete pump from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists horizontal pumping distance as 25 m and does not list a vertical delivery entry. It does list 15 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, a 0.1 m³ hopper and aggregate 2 cm and below. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Levelling.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台的电动10系列混凝土泵把水平输送距离写成 25 m，没有标出垂直输送格。它标出了 15 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、料斗 0.1 m³ 和骨料 2 cm 及以下。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Levelling。

body.en: Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Levelling. The picture shows Tide station leveling. The Electric 10 Series concrete pump from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists horizontal pumping distance as 25 m and does not list a vertical delivery entry. A missing line stays missing. 21 m³/h is higher than Electric 20's 8–10 m³/h, yet Electric 20 is the page that lists a vertical figure, 40 m, inside 120 m / 40 m. The factory is in Xingtai.
body.zh: 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Levelling。画面是Tide station leveling。河北品锦机械在邢台的电动10系列混凝土泵把水平输送距离写成 25 m，没有标出垂直输送格。河北品锦机械没有写成 25 m / 某个数。

body.en: It does list 15 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, a 0.1 m³ hopper and aggregate 2 cm and below. The label is horizontal pumping distance. Output and vertical distance are different columns.
body.zh: 它标出了 15 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、料斗 0.1 m³ 和骨料 2 cm 及以下。21 m³/h 高于电动20的 8–10 m³/h，但写出垂直数字的是电动20，在 120 m / 40 m 里垂直是 40 m。

body.en: Electric 15's vertical range of 15–20 m is not an Electric 10 figure. There is no second number hiding in that entry. If a job needs a vertical figure, do not borrow one.
body.zh: 电动15的垂直范围 15–20 m 不是电动10的数字。请用 /zh/contact/ 并写明电动10系列。

body.en: B500S-83D's 5 m vertical is not either. Hebei Pinjin Machinery did not write 25 m / something. Use /en/contact/ and name Electric 10 Series.
body.zh: B500S-83D 的垂直 5 m 也不是。

question.zh: 写出的水平距离是多少？

answer.en: 25 m. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Levelling.

question.en: On this row: Is there a vertical metre on the page?

answer.en: No vertical delivery entry is shown. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Levelling.
answer.zh: 没有标出垂直输送格。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Levelling画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Can I use Electric 15's 15–20 m?
question.zh: 可以用电动15的 15–20 m 吗？

answer.en: No. That range is shown on Electric 15 only. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Levelling.
answer.zh: 不能。那个范围只标出在电动15上。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Levelling画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: What is the hopper?

answer.en: 0.1 m³, the smallest hopper volume shown on these concrete pump sheets. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Levelling.
answer.zh: 0.1 m³，是这些混凝土泵参数页里写出的最小料斗容积。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Levelling画面里印出的数字。
